scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to ask for a PIN, address, or security question within the first 4 minutes of the call.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Failed to show empathy to customer's frustration.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent deflected responsibility or blamed another team instead of owning the issue.

grader.graded_by: Claude (written and graded before any model run; not human-reviewed)
grader.notes: V: no PIN/address/security question in the first 4 minutes (the agent asks only for the email). E: customer upset about being double-charged; not acknowledged. AL: asks for the amount and the date again after they were given. O: "Payment problems are the bank's issue really, I'd ring them first." CR: the duplicate is refunded and the customer confirms she can see the refund in the app.
